content.short: Unit Protocol enables minting USDP stablecoin using a wide range of crypto assets as collateral.
content.description: Unit Protocol enables minting of USDP, a stablecoin, by posting a wide range of assets as collateral. More than 160 different coins can be used, including LP tokens, which provide value for liquidity providers even when other collateral fluctuates. The protocol collects stability fees when users repay USDP and applies liquidation fees if CDPs are liquidated. This process is governed by the $DUCK governance token.
content.meta: Unit Protocol lets you mint USDP stablecoin using various coins as collateral. Discover Unit Protocol and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
